import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mbregex_stack_limit2.phpt","function":"mb_trim","line":13,"var":"$encoded_char_list","code":"$encoded_char_list = implode( \"|\", array_merge( array( \"\\s\",\"\\t\",\"\\n\",\"\\r\", \"\\0\", \"\\x0B\" ), $chars_array ) );","note":"The pattern is built as a large alternation from attacker-controlled characters, creating a complex regex AST."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mbregex_stack_limit2.phpt","function":"mb_trim","line":15,"var":"pattern","code":"$string = mb_ereg_replace( \"^($encoded_char_list)*\", \"\", $string );","note":"The quantified alternation is compiled through mb_ereg_replace, exercising the Oniguruma optimizer path under stack pressure."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_replace)","line":1224,"var":"pattern","code":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_eregi_replace)","note":"mb_eregi_replace is another entry point into the shared mbregex compilation and execution machinery."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":1410,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax))","note":"The attacker-controlled pattern is compiled and stored in the shared search_re slot before execution."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When the quantified body can match empty, Oniguruma recursively classifies the subtree for memory-node and repeat interactions."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, matching the reported state names."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"Nested list/alt nodes are traversed recursively, so a crafted pattern can force repeated visits through the same logical subtree."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4949,"var":"en->te.Then","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Then);","note":"Conditional subtrees are also recursively analyzed, increasing the chance of hitting the vulnerable optimizer path with complex patterns."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is executed against the subject string; if the vulnerable compiler state is reached, the crash manifests during regex processing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
